fix.notes: The fix adds one extra DB query per homepage load (the tournament top-8 lookup). This is lightweight — it returns at most 8 rows using an indexed subquery on competition.end_date. The deduplication ensures no deck appears twice in the deck tables even when the tournament is recent enough to also appear in the 500-deck window.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

`latest_decks()` in `decksite/data/deck.py` fetches at most 500 decks ordered by `active_date DESC`. When a tournament is held but many league games occur afterwards, the tournament's decks fall outside the LIMIT 500 window. The `Home.setup_decks()` view iterates through this list looking for the first Gatherling deck to populate the "Latest Tournament Top 8" section — if none appears, the section is omitted entirely.

This was confirmed by the issue author: competition_id 3349 (PD Sundays 18.01) was the most recent tournament but was not showing on the homepage.

## What changed

Added `_latest_tournament_top8()` in `decksite/data/deck.py` that queries for the most recent completed Gatherling competition's top-8 decks (finish <= 8) using a subquery on competition end_date. `latest_decks()` now prepends these tournament decks (deduplicated against the regular 500) so they always appear at the head of the list passed to the Home view.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (18s)
- Diff is 23 added lines in one file, all serving #7924

Fixes #7924
fix.pr_title: Always show latest tournament top 8 on homepage (#7924)

evidence.detail: latest_decks() uses LIMIT 500 AND d.created_date > UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY); if 500+ non-tournament decks were created in that window, no tournament decks are returned

home page iterates the deck list from latest_decks() to find the first Gatherling competition_id; if none appear in the list, tournament_decks stays empty and the 'Latest Tournament Top 8' section is omitted
bakert comment confirms root cause: 'This is because we grab the last 500 decks. If the most recent 500 decks does not include any tournament decks we won't get the tournament.'

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/deck.py, remove the 'created_date > UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)' clause from latest_decks() so that all seasons' recent decks up to LIMIT 500 are considered, ensuring low-volume tournament weeks still appear. Alternatively, load the most recent completed tournament's decks via a separate load_competitions() query in decksite/main.py and pass them to Home alongside the latest_decks list.
triage.notes: Removing the 30-day filter is the one-line fix. The separate-query approach is safer if high deck volume returns; either is under 20 changed lines with no schema changes.
